ledger.title: A connective condition with a `sizeof` leaf stays refused: `LZ4_hashPosition`, 1 sole-blocker row on current
ledger.text: Registered by K2-NO-TYPED-ACCESS. `if ((sizeof(reg_t)==8) && (tableType != byU16))` (lz4.c:783): rule 5h's leaf reader refuses the `sizeof` leaf (``C operator `sizeof` requires type/operand analysis``) and the elaborator's condition lowering refuses the CG06 region (``unlisted form: event outside this card's lowering``: `lower_events` lowers no Branch/Merge). Generic probes on 5087f9295: `if (sizeof(long) == 8)` Safe, `if ((t == 8) && (t != 2))` Safe, `if ((sizeof(long) == 8) && (t != 2))` Unknown, `return (sizeof(long) == 8) && (t != 2);` Safe. DISCHARGE: lower such a condition as rule 10z's value region then a branch refining no edge, admitted only when ∀ e ∈ events(region). e ∈ {Read(x) | automatic(x) ∧ ¬addr_taken(x)} ∪ {Branch, Merge}, with a Lean model and near-miss fixtures (`p && p->x`, a call in an arm), measured; or record the shape as outside the projection.

ledger.title: A call-free `sizeof` statement of the flexible-allocation size stays refused: `rd_kafka_share_partition_offsets_list_new`, 1 sole-blocker row on current
ledger.text: Registered by K2-NO-TYPED-ACCESS. `size = sizeof(*list) + (capacity * sizeof(rd_kafka_share_partition_offsets_t *));` (rdkafka_share_acknowledgement.c:1120; the sibling at :1082 is on a row with another blocker). Lexical gate: `indirect memory access is outside the resource projection`; the elaborator: `unlisted form: write to an object the gateway does not read as a scalar local` (real-unit probe on 5087f9295); W44-COLLECTION-ALLOCATION's unevaluated-operand reading covers `sizeof(*v)` only in a statement whose first call is an ordinary callee, and generic probes refuse exactly `s = sizeof(*b) + (n * sizeof(char *));` while admitting it without the parentheses. C11 6.5.3.4p2: an operand whose type is not variably modified is not evaluated. DISCHARGE: read the operand as W44-COLLECTION-ALLOCATION's unevaluated operand in this position too, admitted only when ¬variably_modified(type(operand)), with a Lean model (no event) and VLA near-miss fixtures, measured.

ledger.title: `__builtin_clz`/`__builtin_ctz` calls stay refused: `LZ4_NbCommonBytes`, `log2_floor`, 2 sole-blocker rows on current; needs a user decision
ledger.text: Registered by K2-NO-TYPED-ACCESS. No contract or table names the bit-count builtins (``call to uncontracted function `__builtin_clz` ``; the elaborator reads a builtin callee as an indirect call, CG22). Their result is undefined at 0. OPEN USER CHOICES: (a) obligation-bearing, call = __builtin_c{l,t}z{,l,ll}(x) ∧ (path ⊢ x ≠ 0) ⇒ custody_neutral(call): admits `log2_floor` (`n == 0 ? -1 : 31 ^ rd_clz(n)`) and not `LZ4_NbCommonBytes` (its `assert(val != 0)` is `((void)0)`); (b) value-only, call = __builtin_c{l,t}z{,l,ll}(x) ⇒ custody_neutral(call): admits both, departing from rule 10s's rule that a node with a C fault case is never custody-neutral; and where the declarations live (not libc). DISCHARGE: the decision, then a table or provider with a Lean model and fixtures, measured.
